scope: Every outgoing Git blob is byte-read and SHA-pinned. ELF and high-confidence private-key/API-key signatures are screened without printing matched contents. This is distribution review, not kernel or mathematical acceptance. Newly created uncommitted history-audit files are outside this dated head and require their own checkpoint review.
